title: Consumer integration guide + example app
description: Make the component genuinely reusable across the user's other projects. Write integration docs covering: installing from the GitHub repo, supplying Sanity `projectId`/`dataset`/`apiVersion`, adding the host origin(s) to Sanity CORS Origins (the silent prod-blocker from guide section 11), wiring the AI hook and the write/signing layer, and the required Sanity schema types the consumer's dataset must have. Ship a minimal example consumer app that mounts both `<BlogAuthor>` and `<BlogPostPreview>`.
acceptance_criteria: A README/integration doc walks through install-from-GitHub plus all required config, including the CORS Origins step.
Required Sanity schema (post + blockContent + image fields) is documented or exported for consumers to add to their Studio.
An example app in the repo installs the package and renders both authoring and preview against a real or stubbed dataset.
Docs state the write-token/permission requirement and link the secure write-path options from TASK-005.

comments.author: init-project
comments.body: Reshaped from generic seed. CORS step is the most-forgotten prod blocker per the guide.
